Game Overview

Pekko Robot is a adventure title where embark on an electrifying adventure in Pekko Robot, where you dash through intricate 2D challenges set in a sleek future world. Overcome cunning foes and perilous traps using agile maneuvers, like double-jumps, as you gather precious chicken eggs. With escalating challenges, prepare for an exhilarating test of skill and strategy.
